blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—No one at the University of the Philippines was happier than Gani Stevens to see Veejay Pre finally break out of his shell. Stevens expressed his delight after Pre rediscovered his rhythm in the Fighting Maroons’ 94-75 victory over Ateneo in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Araneta Coliseum on Saturday. READ: UAAP: Newcomers Veejay Pre, James Payosing shine for UP Pre couldn’t quite showcase his full arsenal in UP’s opening-day win over the University of Santo Tomas.
